provenance.method: Work expansion using current Great Britain Access to Work eligibility and separate Northern Ireland Access to Work route.

question: I am self-employed and disabled or neurodivergent. What work-support routes can I inspect in the UK?
why_it_matters: Self-employed people can miss support because workplace-adjustment information is often written around an employee and employer relationship.
current_understanding: The current Great Britain Access to Work eligibility route includes self-employment subject to its current conditions. Northern Ireland has a separate Access to Work (NI) programme and must not be treated as the same scheme. ND Oracle can route to the programmes but cannot decide eligibility, award amount or business viability.
evidence_needed: Current practical guidance on evidence and accessibility for self-employed Access to Work applicants.
Broader support routes for self-employed disabled people beyond Access to Work.
reopening_conditions: Either Access to Work programme changes its self-employment rules.
A new national self-employment support route becomes relevant.
dissent: Access to Work can address some disability-related work costs but is not general business funding or income support.
